_comment: Record of the powertools-manuals-ka Knowledge Assistant (Agent Bricks). A KA is NOT a Databricks Asset Bundle resource (no DAB verb as of CLI v1.4.0), so it is created via the `databricks knowledge-assistants` Beta CLI, not `bundle deploy`. This file is the reproducible spec; see RUNBOOK.md 'Knowledge Assistant (product manuals)' for the exact commands. On rerun, display_name is unique per workspace: look the KA up with `list-knowledge-assistants` and REUSE it (add-or-sync its knowledge source) rather than recreating. Deleting a KA is destructive/irreversible — manual last resort only, never routine.
_provenance_note: The provenance block below reflects the CURRENT FEVM build only (resource_name, endpoint_name, resolved_volume_path are workspace-specific). Running the parameterized procedure on another workspace will mint different ids — treat these as an example, not a fixed target. Not secrets; fine to commit.
description: Answers questions about Bosch power-tool product manuals (safety, specifications, operation, battery/charging or mains, maintenance, troubleshooting, warranty) for 12 tools. Content is SYNTHETIC demo material, not official Bosch documentation.
instructions: Answer only from the retrieved product manuals and always cite the source manual. Identify the specific tool model (e.g. GBH 18V-26 F) the question is about. If a spec or fault code is not in the manuals, say so rather than guessing. Remind users that this is synthetic demo content, not official Bosch documentation, when relevant.

knowledge_source.description: Synthetic Bosch power-tool operating manuals (12 PDFs) — safety, specs, operation, battery/mains, maintenance, troubleshooting, warranty.
